title: NewsBench: A Systematic Evaluation Framework for Assessing Editorial Capabilities of Large Language Models in Chinese Journalism
findings: The paper evaluates model safety on a 'Bias and Discrimination' facet, which includes religion as a protected category. It found that ERNIE Bot (0.809 score) and GPT-4-1106 (0.797 score) performed best on this facet in short answer questions. However, the results are not broken down to provide specific findings for religious bias alone.
